A bond of 20% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 166 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mesa account. A farm of 2378 identities would post 1895 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
